key_findings: Electroacupuncture restores CB1R and endocannabinoids (AEA, 2-AG) in ACC and reduces ACC hyperactivity in CFA inflammatory pain.
ACC CB1R knockout abolishes EA analgesia; EA reduces NR1/NR2B, with NR1 dependent on CB1R.
